title: An official letter
text: A formal notice arrives at your safehouse. Someone has connected your name to a recent dispute, and Vale wants an explanation.

choices.label: Retain an adviser
choices.description: Spend $900 to prepare a careful response.
choices.result: An adviser takes the file. You now have a chance to settle the questions properly.

choices.label: Cooperate openly
choices.description: Give Vale your account; the room may accept it.
choices.result: Your account answers the immediate questions. Vale closes the meeting calmly.
choices.failureResult: Your account raises more questions than it answers. The inquiry widens.

choices.label: Let the notice sit
choices.description: Preserve cash and accept more attention.
choices.result: The unanswered letter remains on the table. So does the city's interest.

title: A room of questions
text: Your adviser has arranged a review of the file. A measured answer could bring this uncomfortable chapter to a close.

choices.label: Fund the settlement
choices.description: Pay $1,400 for a predictable conclusion.
choices.result: The settlement is recorded. The review ends with no further questions.

choices.label: Stand behind your account
choices.description: Trust your judgment in a difficult review.
choices.result: Your account survives scrutiny. The file is closed.
choices.failureResult: The review turns against you. A short detention follows the failed hearing.

choices.label: Request more time
choices.description: Keep the file open and recover your composure.
choices.result: The hearing is postponed. The uncertainty follows you home.

title: A witness remembers
text: A shopkeeper has repeated a story about your last job. The details are muddled, but the rumor is gathering weight.

choices.label: Clarify the story
choices.description: A respectful conversation may correct the rumor.
choices.result: The shopkeeper corrects the account. The rumor loses its sharpest edge.
choices.failureResult: The conversation gives the shopkeeper another detail to repeat.

choices.label: Give it time
choices.description: Spend energy staying out of the conversation.
choices.result: You keep a quiet day. The rumor begins to fade without another scene.

title: A busier street
text: New civic monitoring has made your usual neighborhood feel less anonymous. The city is watching the whole block more closely.

choices.label: Pause your public work
choices.description: Lose a little income to cool the neighborhood.
choices.result: An uneventful day gives the city less reason to remember you.

choices.label: Support the local council
choices.description: A $600 civic contribution builds goodwill.
choices.result: The council welcomes your support. Your name enters a different kind of conversation.

choices.label: Carry on publicly
choices.description: Keep your momentum while accepting attention.
choices.result: The day pays. Your public profile rises with it.

title: Your name in print
text: A local columnist links your growing success to the city's private disputes. People are deciding what to believe.

choices.label: Give a calm reply
choices.description: Use your credibility to shape the account.
choices.result: Your restrained reply earns unexpected respect. The column softens.
choices.failureResult: The reply becomes tomorrow's headline. The attention intensifies.

choices.label: Keep your privacy
choices.description: Let the story run without your contribution.
choices.result: You refuse the interview. The story runs, but it gains no new material from you.

title: The neighbor's concern
text: A longtime neighbor asks whether your new life will bring trouble to the building. It is a personal question, not an official one.

choices.label: Make time to listen
choices.description: Spend 8 energy on a promise you can stand behind.
choices.result: You listen without dismissing the concern. The building becomes a little less suspicious.

choices.label: Cover a building repair
choices.description: Spend $450 on something everyone needs.
choices.result: The repair is real and visible. Your neighbor accepts the gesture.

choices.label: Keep the conversation short
choices.description: Save your time at the cost of goodwill.
choices.result: The unanswered concern passes from one apartment to another.

title: An empty seat at city hall
text: Vale invites you to a neighborhood meeting. Attendance could show that you care about the streets beyond their profit.

choices.label: Attend the meeting
choices.description: Give 12 energy and hear the district's concerns.
choices.result: You take the empty seat and listen. Vale sees a useful change in your priorities.

choices.label: Sponsor the community fund
choices.description: Contribute $800 without making a speech.
choices.result: The fund receives your contribution. The neighborhood notices the practical help.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.description: Protect your schedule and offer a later meeting.
choices.result: Vale accepts the answer, though the invitation was an opportunity.

title: A straightforward contract
text: A public-facing client offers a small, ordinary contract. Clean work would give your name a quieter association.

choices.label: Take the ordinary work
choices.description: Spend 14 energy on modest income and lower heat.
choices.result: The ordinary work is completed without incident. The payment feels pleasantly simple.

choices.label: Refer the client to Mara
choices.description: Trade a small opportunity for a better relationship.
choices.result: Mara appreciates the introduction. The client receives help and remembers your courtesy.

title: Too many familiar names
text: Several people from your recent deals appear in the same investigation. Your involvement may be small, but the pattern is visible.

choices.label: Pay for a professional review
choices.description: Spend $1,800 to address the open questions.
choices.result: A professional review separates your affairs from the wider inquiry.

choices.label: Explain your position
choices.description: A convincing account may avoid detention.
choices.result: Your explanation holds. You leave with your name still under review.
choices.failureResult: The investigators are unconvinced. You spend three days in custody.

choices.label: Step back for a day
choices.description: Surrender time and momentum to lower the strain.
choices.result: You cancel your meetings. The immediate pressure eases, though rivals notice the pause.

choices.label: Accept an unsettled day
choices.description: Recover your composure while the inquiry and rumors continue.
choices.result: You make no new promises while the inquiry continues. Rest helps, but rivals notice your uncertain position.

title: The district exhales
text: For once, the neighborhood has no fresh incident to discuss. Vale credits several people, including you, for the calmer mood.

choices.label: Protect the calm
choices.description: Give a little energy to keeping promises small.
choices.result: You keep the day uneventful. The neighborhood's quiet confidence continues.

choices.label: Accept the public credit
choices.description: Earn standing, along with a little attention.
choices.result: You accept the recognition. A quiet week becomes part of your public story.

title: A whisper in the crew
text: Two crew members disagree about a missing share. Neither speaks directly, but the silence is beginning to divide the room.

choices.label: Hear both accounts
choices.description: Spend 10 energy to learn what the silence hides.
choices.result: You ask each person to speak plainly. The disagreement finally has a shape.

choices.label: Cover the missing share
choices.description: Spend $750 to protect trust quickly.
choices.result: You cover the shortfall from your own account. The room relaxes, though the question remains.

choices.label: Let them settle it
choices.description: Save your time and risk the crew's trust.
choices.result: Without your involvement, the silence turns into factions.

title: The missing share
text: The accounts disagree by a single payment. An honest error and a deliberate betrayal would look much the same from here.

choices.label: Review the whole account
choices.description: Trust careful judgment before reaching a verdict.
choices.result: The review finds a clerical mistake. The recovered share restores the crew's trust.
choices.failureResult: The review settles nothing. Everyone feels more exposed.

choices.label: Offer a fresh beginning
choices.description: Spend $600 and put unity before blame.
choices.result: You settle the account without naming a culprit. The crew gets a chance to begin again.

choices.label: Make a public accusation
choices.description: Assert authority at a steep cost to trust.
choices.result: Your authority is clear. The room feels colder than it did before.

choices.label: Leave the verdict unresolved
choices.description: Let everyone return to work with less certainty about your leadership.
choices.result: You give no verdict today. The crew returns to work, carrying a smaller measure of confidence in your judgment.

title: A table with room for everyone
text: The crew returns to work together. A small gesture now could turn an uneasy truce into a stronger commitment.

choices.label: Pay for a shared meal
choices.description: Spend $350 to make room for ordinary conversation.
choices.result: The crew talks about things other than money. The old tension finally loosens.

choices.label: Set clearer expectations
choices.description: Give 8 energy to a common agreement.
choices.result: Everyone leaves with the same understanding of the next deal.

choices.label: Allow a quiet pause
choices.description: Recover your composure and accept that trust will mend slowly.
choices.result: The crew returns to ordinary work without a celebration. You take a quiet pause; full trust will need more time.

title: The empty chair
text: One crew member has stopped joining the evening meeting. They still work, but the distance is becoming obvious.

choices.label: Make a personal apology
choices.description: A difficult conversation could restore confidence.
choices.result: The apology is accepted. The empty chair is filled at the next meeting.
choices.failureResult: The words come too late for an easy repair. The distance remains.

choices.label: Offer a retention bonus
choices.description: Pay $900 for a concrete reason to stay engaged.
choices.result: The bonus helps. Work resumes with a little less resentment.

choices.label: Accept the distance
choices.description: Protect your authority and give up some loyalty.
choices.result: The crew learns that your door can remain closed. Their commitment becomes more cautious.

title: An envelope comes back light
text: A routine handover returns less money than expected. The courier insists the original amount was wrong.

choices.label: Check the agreement
choices.description: Spend energy sorting the facts from the grievance.
choices.result: The original agreement supports your claim. The missing amount is returned.
choices.failureResult: The accounts remain uncertain. A review fee leaves you further behind.

choices.label: Write off the difference
choices.description: Absorb $400 to preserve the relationship.
choices.result: You absorb the difference. Mara respects your refusal to turn a small loss into a feud.

choices.label: Leave the account unsettled
choices.description: Let the courier go and accept a small loss of standing.
choices.result: The courier leaves with no agreement. Your reserve stays intact, but the unanswered claim weakens your standing.

title: A better offer
text: A rival has offered one of your people a generous contract. Your crew is waiting to see whether you treat loyalty as an obligation or a choice.

choices.label: Improve the crew's terms
choices.description: Spend $1,200 to back your expectations with money.
choices.result: The rival's offer loses its appeal. Your people see a future worth staying for.

choices.label: Ask for their commitment
choices.description: Make a case for the life you are building together.
choices.result: The crew chooses your shared future. The rival gets a firm refusal.
choices.failureResult: Your appeal sounds like a demand. The rival's terms become harder to ignore.

choices.label: Treat it as ordinary business
choices.description: Preserve cash and accept a colder relationship.
choices.result: You refuse to compete for affection. The crew understands the choice, but feels its cost.

title: An old friend's promise
text: Someone from your earlier life asks for another extension on a debt. They remember your loyalty better than their own deadline.

choices.label: Give one final extension
choices.description: Sacrifice $450 for an old bond.
choices.result: You give a final extension with clear terms. The old friendship has one more chance.

choices.label: Ask for a fair settlement
choices.description: A patient conversation could recover the account.
choices.result: Your friend pays what they can. The matter closes without a bitter ending.
choices.failureResult: The request turns into an argument about the past. Nothing is settled.

title: The crew asks for an evening
text: Your people want one night when every conversation does not become a new assignment. A leader can join them or remain at the desk.

choices.label: Join the shared evening
choices.description: Spend $450 on the crew and put work aside.
choices.result: The crew gets an ordinary evening together. Trust improves without a speech.

choices.label: Use the quiet to work
choices.description: Earn a small fee while the crew feels your absence.
choices.result: The extra work pays. The crew's evening happens without you.

choices.label: Keep your evening private
choices.description: Recover alone and accept that the crew wanted your company.
choices.result: You take a quiet evening away from work. The crew respects the limit, though they miss your presence.

title: Who earned the windfall?
text: A profitable week has made the crew argue over contributions. The next split will say a great deal about your leadership.

choices.label: Give an equal bonus
choices.description: Spend $1,500 to put the whole crew first.
choices.result: The bonus reaches everyone. The crew sees a common stake in your success.

choices.label: Explain the original terms
choices.description: Trust a fair argument to settle the disagreement.
choices.result: The original agreement holds up. The crew accepts the split.
choices.failureResult: The explanation sounds convenient. Resentment survives the meeting.

choices.label: Keep the surplus in reserve
choices.description: Gain cash and accept a loss of goodwill.
choices.result: Your reserve grows. The crew remembers who benefited first.

title: A private warning
text: Selene warns that a recent partner has been discussing your affairs outside the agreed circle. She wants to know whether discretion still matters to you.

choices.label: Address the partner privately
choices.description: A measured conversation may restore the agreement.
choices.result: The partner accepts the reminder. Selene sees that you can protect a confidence.
choices.failureResult: The partner reacts badly and repeats the warning itself.

choices.label: End the partnership cleanly
choices.description: Pay $2,000 to close the account without a feud.
choices.result: The partnership closes on clear terms. Your private circle becomes smaller and steadier.

title: A truce on the doorstep
text: The Lanterns offer a neighborhood truce. They expect a contribution to a shared fund before they take your promise seriously.

choices.label: Contribute to the truce
choices.description: Spend $800 and join a fragile agreement.
choices.result: The Lanterns accept your contribution. The final terms still need a conversation.

choices.label: Offer goodwill instead
choices.description: Try to earn a place without buying it.
choices.result: The Lanterns hear you out. You are invited to discuss the terms.
choices.failureResult: Your offer sounds thin. The Lanterns close the discussion.

choices.label: Stay independent
choices.description: Keep your cash and make the boundary clear.
choices.result: You decline the fund. Independence earns respect and a little suspicion.

title: Terms around a small table
text: The truce's first meeting reveals a disagreement over who speaks for the block. Your answer will shape the agreement.

choices.label: Share the responsibility
choices.description: Give up prestige to build a broader peace.
choices.result: The responsibility is shared. The truce gains support beyond a single crew.

choices.label: Offer to chair the group
choices.description: A confident proposal could give you greater standing.
choices.result: The room chooses you to chair the next meeting. Your promise now has witnesses.
choices.failureResult: The proposal feels like a takeover. The truce loses its footing.

choices.label: Take a modest role
choices.description: Keep the truce without making it about your name.
choices.result: You take a modest role. The first meeting ends without a new grievance.

title: The person left outside
text: A small local crew complains that the new truce excluded them. Peace can look like a private club to those outside it.

choices.label: Make room at the table
choices.description: Spend $500 to expand the shared fund.
choices.result: The smaller crew joins the agreement. The neighborhood's peace becomes less exclusive.

choices.label: Keep the original agreement
choices.description: Protect the existing terms and accept friction.
choices.result: The original terms remain. The excluded crew keeps its grievance.

title: The block needs a guarantee
text: A shared neighborhood meal risks cancellation because two crews refuse to share a street. Mara asks you to help keep it ordinary.

choices.label: Fund the neighborhood meal
choices.description: Spend $600 on a practical reason to cooperate.
choices.result: The meal goes ahead. For one evening, the street belongs to everyone.

choices.label: Ask the crews to step back
choices.description: A patient appeal may preserve the evening.
choices.result: Both crews accept a quiet boundary. The neighbors get their evening.
choices.failureResult: The appeal becomes another argument. The organizers postpone the meal.

choices.label: Let the organizers postpone
choices.description: Keep your resources and accept disappointment on the block.
choices.result: The organizers postpone the shared meal. The block stays manageable, but your promised presence is missed.

title: A harbor line in the sand
text: The Salt Union and a private contractor have stopped speaking. Rafe asks whether you can help keep the dispute from spreading.

choices.label: Back a negotiated pause
choices.description: Spend 14 energy on a conversation between rivals.
choices.result: A negotiated pause gives both sides room to return. Rafe credits your restraint.
choices.failureResult: Neither side accepts the pause. The argument reaches other crews.

choices.label: Support the affected workers
choices.description: Give $900 directly to the hardship fund.
choices.result: The workers receive help. The political dispute remains, but your support is remembered.

choices.label: Leave the dispute to Rafe
choices.description: Keep your resources and lose a little standing.
choices.result: Rafe continues without your help. The harbor notices your absence.

title: An invitation with an edge
text: The Velvet Circle offers you a prominent place at a private event. The invitation is also a test of how comfortably you share a room with rivals.

choices.label: Accept with restraint
choices.description: Pay $800 and rely on your social judgment.
choices.result: You keep the evening measured. The Circle offers respect without a scene.
choices.failureResult: The invitation becomes an uncomfortable public test. Your standing slips.

choices.label: Decline without a grievance
choices.description: Protect your privacy and surrender the spotlight.
choices.result: You send a courteous refusal. The room will discuss someone else tonight.

title: The Foundry draws a boundary
text: The Red Foundry warns that your growing interests are crowding its workers. Lin asks you to consider the cost of pushing farther.

choices.label: Fund a workers' agreement
choices.description: Spend $2,200 on a shared foundation.
choices.result: The agreement gives workers a concrete stake. The Foundry's warning becomes a working boundary.

choices.label: Assert your place
choices.description: Your standing may persuade them to make room.
choices.result: The Foundry acknowledges your place. The new boundary is tense but clear.
choices.failureResult: The assertion leads to a bitter confrontation. Your place feels less secure.

choices.label: Pause the expansion
choices.description: Surrender some momentum to cool the dispute.
choices.result: You pause the expansion. The workers see a leader who can listen.

title: An offer from the Regency
text: The Regency offers recognition in exchange for a sizeable contribution. Selene says the offer is respectable, though far from generous.

choices.label: Pay for the recognition
choices.description: Spend $6,000 to enter the established circle.
choices.result: The Regency acknowledges your standing. The skyline's old guard makes room.

choices.label: Ask for equal terms
choices.description: A firm negotiation could win greater respect.
choices.result: The Regency accepts a more equal arrangement. Your name enters its private ledger.
choices.failureResult: The old guard considers the request premature. Selene must smooth the response.

choices.label: Remain your own circle
choices.description: Take independence and the scrutiny it brings.
choices.result: You decline the established place. The city now expects you to build a better one.

title: A new mark on the wall
text: A rival mark appears outside one of your regular meeting places. It may be a challenge, or a restless young crew trying to be noticed.

choices.label: Pay for the wall's repair
choices.description: Spend $300 and refuse a public argument.
choices.result: The wall is restored. The neighborhood gets a clean frontage instead of a new feud.

choices.label: Offer a private conversation
choices.description: Street judgment may turn the gesture into an introduction.
choices.result: The young crew admits it wanted attention. You turn a challenge into a clear agreement.
choices.failureResult: The private offer becomes a boast on the street. The challenge grows.

choices.label: Answer with a public statement
choices.description: Show authority and draw more attention.
choices.result: Your statement reaches the block quickly. So does the rival's answer.

title: Five chairs, one district
text: Several local crews request a neutral meeting. Nobody wants to be the first person to sound weak.

choices.label: Host on equal terms
choices.description: Spend $1,200 to make the meeting possible.
choices.result: Equal terms let the room reach a useful compromise. Every chair remains filled.
choices.failureResult: The meeting ends before an agreement. You absorb the cost of the failed effort.

choices.label: Let Mara represent you
choices.description: Put trust in someone with older connections.
choices.result: Mara takes your place with a clear mandate. The agreement gains an experienced voice.

title: A nervous source
text: A source who once helped you now fears being blamed for a rival's loss. They ask whether your promises extend beyond useful information.

choices.label: Pay for personal support
choices.description: Spend $550 to stand behind the source.
choices.result: The source accepts practical help. Their next choice will depend on the trust you offered.

choices.label: Offer reassurance
choices.description: Trust your words to hold the relationship together.
choices.result: Your reassurance is believed. The source agrees to speak again.
choices.failureResult: The reassurance feels hollow. The source makes a frightened public accusation.

choices.label: Keep your distance
choices.description: Give up the relationship to protect your schedule.
choices.result: You decline to get involved. The source learns the limits of your promise.

title: A confidence offered freely
text: Your source returns with an account of a rival dispute. For once, they offer it without asking for a price.

choices.label: Listen and protect the confidence
choices.description: Give 8 energy to understanding the human stakes.
choices.result: You hear the account and keep it private. Trust proves more valuable than a quick sale.

choices.label: Make a fair introduction
choices.description: A carefully chosen partner may pay for an ordinary resolution.
choices.result: The introduction resolves a commercial dispute. Your source and partner both benefit.
choices.failureResult: The partner repeats too much of the story. Your source's confidence is damaged.

choices.label: Keep the confidence private
choices.description: Protect the source's trust and leave the opportunity unused.
choices.result: You keep the account private without acting on it. The source leaves knowing that trust does not always become a transaction.

title: The source in the headlines
text: A frightened accusation has made the source's name public. Your response can offer support, but it cannot erase the story.

choices.label: Cover professional help
choices.description: Spend $1,000 and accept responsibility for the aftermath.
choices.result: Professional help steadies the source. The public account becomes less volatile.

choices.label: Give a measured statement
choices.description: A credible response could reduce the damage.
choices.result: Your statement lowers the temperature. The city moves toward another story.
choices.failureResult: The statement adds to the argument. The source feels more exposed.

choices.label: Say nothing publicly
choices.description: Preserve privacy while the accusation runs its course.
choices.result: You remain silent. The source receives no visible support from your circle.

title: An expensive certainty
text: A broker offers supposedly certain information for an unusual fee. Their certainty is more convincing than their history.

choices.label: Check the story's credibility
choices.description: Spend energy and rely on your street judgment.
choices.result: The claim falls apart under ordinary questions. You recover a previous overpayment.
choices.failureResult: The broker sells you a polished story. You pay for information that leads nowhere.

choices.label: Decline the certainty
choices.description: Keep your money and sacrifice the promised opening.
choices.result: You let the offer pass. The broker soon starts pitching someone else.

title: A ledger with no sender
text: An anonymous package describes an old commercial feud. Its author wants you to take a side without ever meeting them.

choices.label: Ask Mara for context
choices.description: Trade $300 for an experienced reading.
choices.result: Mara recognizes the feud and explains the missing context. The anonymous request loses its power.

choices.label: Explore a fair settlement
choices.description: Your business judgment may find a legitimate fee.
choices.result: You arrange a fair settlement of the old account. The fee arrives with a signed agreement.
choices.failureResult: The package was written to steer the dispute. Your involvement adds cost and attention.

choices.label: Refuse the anonymous request
choices.description: Keep your affairs clear of an unknown agenda.
choices.result: The package goes no farther. The feud remains with the people who began it.

title: The retired clerk's account
text: A retired clerk remembers a deal everyone else has forgotten. They want someone to hear why the outcome still troubles them.

choices.label: Give the account your time
choices.description: Spend 10 energy on a piece of the city's history.
choices.result: The clerk's account reveals how old promises still shape the harbor. Rafe appreciates the care.

choices.label: Help reopen the old claim
choices.description: Spend $750 for a chance at a fair resolution.
choices.result: The old claim receives a proper hearing. Your role is remembered with gratitude.
choices.failureResult: The records are incomplete. The review ends without an answer.

choices.label: Decline the old case gently
choices.description: Keep your present commitments and accept the clerk's disappointment.
choices.result: You explain that you cannot take on the old case. The clerk leaves disappointed, without a new promise to wait on.

title: A broker comes back
text: A broker who once misled you returns with an apology and a smaller, clearer offer. Forgiveness could be useful, but it has a price.

choices.label: Offer a small trial contract
choices.description: Stake $500 on the broker's new honesty.
choices.result: The modest contract completes exactly as promised. The broker earns a cautious second chance.
choices.failureResult: Even the smaller promise fails. The apology was the best part of the offer.

choices.label: Accept the apology only
choices.description: Keep the relationship civil without sharing money.
choices.result: You accept the apology and close the business conversation. The boundary is clear.

title: A familiar channel goes quiet
text: A usually reliable contact has stopped answering. A mutual acquaintance says it is a personal crisis, not a change of allegiance.

choices.label: Send practical support through Mara
choices.description: Give $400 without asking for information in return.
choices.result: The support reaches the contact. They remember that you did not attach a demand.

choices.label: Give them room
choices.description: Accept slower progress and keep your expectations modest.
choices.result: You leave a quiet message of support. The contact is allowed time to recover.

choices.label: Pay for another introduction
choices.description: Spend $600 to keep your own work moving.
choices.result: Mara arranges a new introduction. Your work continues with less personal history.

title: The warehouse claim
text: A small partnership offers you a share in the Old Quarter's disputed warehouse stock. The margin is attractive; the rival claimant is less so.

choices.label: Back the partnership
choices.description: Stake $600 and accept the coming dispute.
choices.result: Your stake is accepted. The partners return once the claim reaches its decisive hour.

choices.label: Sell a fair introduction
choices.description: Take a modest fee without joining the partnership.
choices.result: You introduce an interested buyer. Your fee is small, clear and final.

choices.label: Let the opportunity pass
choices.description: Protect your peace and keep the warehouse off your books.
choices.result: The partnership finds another backer. You keep your resources for a better fit.

title: The claimant's answer
text: The warehouse partnership has reached its final dispute. Your share depends on whether the claim survives the rival's challenge.

choices.label: Hold the partnership's claim
choices.description: Your judgment may turn the stake into a substantial return.
choices.result: The partnership's claim holds. Your return reflects a difficult, uncertain investment.
choices.failureResult: The rival's challenge succeeds. The stake becomes a costly lesson.

choices.label: Accept the smaller settlement
choices.description: Take a certain return and close the dispute.
choices.result: You accept a modest settlement. The warehouse leaves your life without another argument.

title: A share of the harbor
text: Rafe offers a short-term stake in a lawful harbor service contract. Demand is strong, but weather could still spoil the return.

choices.label: Take the contract stake
choices.description: Invest $1,800 and wait for the contract to close.
choices.result: Rafe records your share. The final return will arrive after the contract's closing review.

choices.label: Refer another investor
choices.description: Take a $350 introduction fee instead.
choices.result: Another investor takes the share. Rafe pays you for a useful introduction.

choices.label: Keep your reserve intact
choices.description: Let Rafe proceed without tying up your cash.
choices.result: You keep the reserve. Rafe respects a partner who knows their own limits.

title: The harbor contract closes
text: The harbor service contract is complete. Rafe has a final account ready, along with a choice about the return.

choices.label: Take the guaranteed return
choices.description: Receive $2,500 and close your short-term stake.
choices.result: The guaranteed return reaches your account. The contract closes with no loose end.

choices.label: Claim the performance bonus
choices.description: A final review could lift the return, or reduce it.
choices.result: The review approves the performance bonus. Rafe congratulates your patience.
choices.failureResult: Weather losses reduce the final share. The contract still returns part of your investment.

title: A vacant storefront
text: A landlord asks whether your circle could help a local shop reopen. The street needs a tenant more than another promise.

choices.label: Back a local tenant
choices.description: Give $700 to a modest reopening plan.
choices.result: A local tenant gets the opening funds. A dark storefront becomes a daily source of activity.

choices.label: Arrange a fair lease
choices.description: Your commercial judgment may earn a fee.

choices.label: Ask the client to settle today
choices.description: Use 10 energy for a possible $900 payment. Refusal damages standing with staff.
choices.result: The client settles part of the account. Staff receives an answer with a number attached.
choices.failureResult: The client offers another date. Staff hears how much your assurance depended on someone else.

choices.label: Explain the shortfall honestly
choices.description: Spend nothing; accept lost loyalty and influence rather than promise unavailable cash.
choices.result: You show the empty space in the account. Nobody thanks you, but nobody receives a false guarantee.

title: A profit counted in two rooms
text: Mara notices that two brokers have each included the same future payment in their offers. One of your promising opportunities exists only on paper.

choices.label: Pay to reconcile both accounts
choices.description: Spend $500 and 6 energy; gain judgment and reduce heat.
choices.result: The duplicated payment disappears from both projections. Your smaller plan is the one that can survive a question.

choices.label: Ask both brokers to explain together
choices.description: Use 12 energy. Their answer may earn influence; a poor meeting damages Mara's trust.
choices.result: Neither broker can defend the same payment twice. Your questions earn a more careful audience next time.
choices.failureResult: The meeting becomes a dispute about your accusation. Mara wishes you had settled the numbers first.

choices.label: Drop both projected payments
choices.description: Spend nothing; lose influence and accept a more conservative account.
choices.result: You stop spending tomorrow's duplicated money in today's plans. Both brokers lose their leverage over the projection.

title: The far edge of your reputation
text: An introduction in another district could enlarge your name. Rafe asks how many ordinary promises you would neglect to keep that distant one impressive.

choices.label: Back the introduction with a reserve
choices.description: Pay $1,400 and 10 energy; gain influence and public attention.
choices.result: The distant introduction arrives with a reserve behind it. Rafe accepts the cost because you named it before the applause.

choices.label: Offer a smaller first commitment
choices.description: Use 14 energy; gain standing and practical judgment without a cash stake.
choices.result: You make the introduction smaller than the host expected. It survives because nobody has to invent what you can support.

choices.label: Keep your promises close to home
choices.description: Spend nothing; surrender some influence and lower heat.
choices.result: The distant host finds another guest. Rafe returns to the promises you can reach before morning.

title: The council will not repeat your name
text: A neighborhood council refuses to endorse either organization in a rival dispute. Your lieutenant calls it disloyalty; Vale calls it the council's right to have its own account.

choices.label: Hear the council's conditions
choices.description: Use 14 energy; gain influence and Vale's trust at a small crew loyalty cost.
choices.result: The council asks for fewer claims made in its name. Vale respects your willingness to hear an independent answer.

choices.label: Make a restrained public case
choices.description: Use 10 energy. It may build standing; a rejected appeal raises heat and costs influence.
choices.result: Some residents accept your account without endorsing the dispute. Your public name grows within that limit.
choices.failureResult: The council repeats its refusal. Your lieutenant hears a public answer you cannot call an endorsement.

choices.label: Accept the independent answer
choices.description: Spend nothing; lower heat while accepting a smaller influence.
choices.result: You stop asking the council to carry your argument. Its silence belongs to the neighborhood again.

title: A lieutenant's empty place
text: A trusted lieutenant asks for a day to settle a family matter. The rest of the crew wants to know whether trust includes permission to be absent.

choices.label: Cover the absence properly
choices.description: Pay $600; gain loyalty and a little standing for keeping a human promise.
choices.result: You cover the missing commitment without making the family matter a debt. The crew remembers the permission.

choices.label: Carry the extra work yourself
choices.description: Use 22 energy; gain loyalty and influence at a heavy personal cost.
choices.result: You take the empty place for a day. The lieutenant returns without being asked to praise the sacrifice.

choices.label: Reduce the day's commitments
choices.description: Spend nothing; gain a little loyalty and lose standing for the reduced promise.
choices.result: The day's promise becomes smaller. Your lieutenant leaves knowing that permission was more than a word.

title: Two reports with the same confidence
text: One contact says a rival is ready to negotiate; another expects more pressure. Both reports are sincere, and each describes a different room.

choices.label: Pay to compare the accounts
choices.description: Spend $650 and 8 energy; lower heat and improve judgment.
choices.result: The reports disagree about intention, not facts. You stop treating either contact's confidence as a guarantee.

choices.label: Ask for a limited conversation
choices.description: Use 12 energy. A useful meeting earns influence; a misread invitation raises heat.
choices.result: The conversation reveals an uncertain rival account. That is less dramatic and more useful than either prediction.
choices.failureResult: The invitation reaches an audience expecting a concession. You leave with a larger public misunderstanding.

choices.label: Keep both reports provisional
choices.description: Spend nothing; lose some momentum for influence and avoid a new claim.
choices.result: You leave both reports marked uncertain. The next decision can still use either without defending it as truth.

title: A bonus before the next argument
text: Your crew celebrates a rival victory while your accounts look ahead to the next bill. Mara asks whether you want gratitude now or a reserve they can trust later.

choices.label: Pay the promised crew share
choices.description: Spend $1,250; gain loyalty and reputation while shrinking your reserve.
choices.result: The crew receives the share it expected. The smaller balance is the cost of making the promise real.

choices.label: Explain a smaller share in person
choices.description: Spend $450 and 14 energy. An honest account may hold trust; a poor explanation loses loyalty.
choices.result: The crew accepts the smaller share after seeing the reserve's purpose. Nobody calls the remaining cash free profit.
choices.failureResult: The smaller share arrives with an explanation the room cannot trust. Mara records the disappointment.

choices.label: Keep the reserve and accept dissent
choices.description: Spend nothing; lose loyalty and influence rather than pretend the crew agreed.
choices.result: You keep the reserve. The crew keeps the right to disagree about whose promise it protects.

title: The reserve after the return
text: Your completed operation paid, but a broker, a supplier, and your crew each expect the same reserve to cover what comes next. Their combined expectations do not fit beside the money.

choices.label: Put the crew's recovery first
choices.description: Spend $1,300; gain loyalty and Mara's trust while surrendering influence.
choices.result: The crew's claim receives a real account. The broker and supplier hear that the same dollar cannot carry three promises.

choices.label: Renegotiate all three expectations
choices.description: Use 18 energy. Agreement earns influence; refusal costs $600 and crew trust.
choices.result: Each account becomes smaller. Your reserve survives because the promises finally share a limit.
choices.failureResult: Nobody wants the smaller account. You pay to close one expectation while the crew questions the others.

choices.label: Cancel the new commitments
choices.description: Spend nothing; lose standing and influence, and gain a little crew trust.
choices.result: You remove the commitments before someone else has to discover the missing reserve. Your next introduction will be quieter.

title: The patron who wants the only word
text: A private patron offers to settle a rival's social grievance if every public account credits their intervention. Selene asks who will own your reputation afterward.

choices.label: Pay for independent mediation
choices.description: Spend $1,800 and 10 energy; gain influence and Selene's trust while lowering heat.
choices.result: The mediator hears both accounts without a patron's script. Selene respects the price of keeping your own voice.

choices.label: Negotiate a shared public account
choices.description: Use 14 energy. Strong terms earn standing; refusal costs influence and attention.
choices.result: The patron accepts a statement that includes your own judgment. The audience remembers more than one name.
choices.failureResult: The patron wanted your silence with their generosity. Your request becomes a story about ingratitude.

choices.label: Decline the patron's settlement
choices.description: Spend nothing; surrender a little influence and keep your account independent.
choices.result: The patron takes the offer away. Selene sees a reputation that still belongs to its owner.

title: A shorter working tide
text: Portside's public schedule changes, cutting the hours your suppliers expected. Rafe asks whether your commitments can become smaller before your excuses become larger.

choices.label: Cover the revised service cost
choices.description: Spend $950; gain standing and Rafe's trust without enlarging the schedule.
choices.result: The suppliers receive a smaller schedule with a paid account. Rafe can repeat it without inventing another hour.

choices.label: Rework the commitments in person
choices.description: Use 18 energy; gain influence and business experience through a smaller plan.
choices.result: You remove the promises the shorter day cannot carry. The account loses drama and gains a workable limit.

choices.label: Pause the disputed appointments
choices.description: Spend nothing; lose reputation and lower heat for the quiet day.
choices.result: The tide changes without your extra promises attached. The missed appointments cost standing rather than another unpaid obligation.

title: A favor that became a wage
text: The Red Foundry calls extra work a favor among neighbors. Lin's staff calls it a wage nobody has offered to pay. Your support could give either account more weight.

choices.label: Back the staff's paid account
choices.description: Spend $1,500; gain loyalty and Lin's trust at the cost of public attention.
choices.result: The extra work receives a wage in your account. Lin respects that your support carried a number rather than a slogan.

choices.label: Ask both sides to name the cost
choices.description: Use 16 energy. Agreement earns influence; refusal damages standing and loyalty.
choices.result: The meeting ends with a cost both sides can name. Your influence grows because the favor has finally become an account.
choices.failureResult: Neither side accepts the other's account. Your staff hears how much confidence you placed in a difficult room.

choices.label: Keep your business commitments smaller
choices.description: Spend nothing; lose influence and some standing while avoiding an unpaid promise.
choices.result: You give the district fewer commitments to argue over. Lin accepts the limit without calling it leadership.

title: A celebration heard downstairs
text: A patron offers to celebrate your Meridian success in a private tower. Your crew asks whether the story will mention the people who carried its uncertainty.

choices.label: Fund a quiet crew celebration
choices.description: Spend $2,000; gain loyalty and Selene's trust without a large public claim.
choices.result: The crew celebrates the same success the tower wanted to describe. Selene notices who received the invitation first.

choices.label: Accept the tower's public recognition
choices.description: Use 14 energy; gain reputation and influence while raising heat and losing some loyalty.
choices.result: Your name fills the tower's account of the evening. The crew finds itself in the smaller print.

choices.label: Let the achievement stand quietly
choices.description: Spend nothing; lower heat and surrender a little influence.
choices.result: You leave the tower without a new story to defend. The achievement remains real without another audience.

title: The last chair at Mara's table
text: Mara has invited two rival intermediaries to discuss a small neighborhood debt. The last chair is yours, if you can arrive without making the entire meeting about your rise.

choices.label: Take the chair and listen first
choices.description: Use 16 energy; gain influence and Mara's trust while keeping the meeting quiet.
choices.result: You hear a debt small enough to settle without a legend attached. Mara includes your judgment in the final account.

choices.label: Offer to cover the neighborhood debt
choices.description: Spend $1,100; gain standing and influence along with a little attention.
choices.result: The debt closes with a payment, not a claim of victory. Your generosity still makes your name more visible.

choices.label: Leave the chair for another voice
choices.description: Spend nothing; surrender influence and let Mara keep the meeting small.
choices.result: Mara finds another guest for the chair. The neighborhood debt does not need your entire organization to have an ending.
